race.comment: MORE RAIN (2) has a strong winning strike-rate this journey here having won five of seven starts. Missed the frame latest (19.87) when fifth over 366m at this track in a Grade 4/5. Looks well placed and should feature. LADY ELLOISE (3) showed good early speed but faded to a close fourth (20.03) at this track over 366m. Cannot be left out. MY MATE NICK (7) jumped from out wide and was game in defeat last start when a 1.5 lengths second (19.95) behind Milchick at this track. Expecting another good run. AERATION (6) must be respected despite an unplaced effort here most recently.
